_note: The people in your party. Each cares most about one side of one issue; steering the manifesto away from it costs their loyalty, and below 25 they quit. Margaret Teyl is the party secretary and always starts in the party. 'side' is L or R of the axis; a figure whose side matches your manifesto starts more loyal.
